## Purpose
Provides `RunSandbox`, the per-user/per-run isolated on-disk workspace that the deepagents filesystem backend is rooted in for every pipeline run, plus helpers to sweep expired run directories and serialize the files an agent wrote into the `filename:`-block deliverable string the frontend parses.

## Shape
- `RunSandbox(user_id, run_id)` — resolves a traversal-proof root (`<RUNS_ROOT>/<user>/<run>/`), exposes `ensure`/`path_for`/`write`/`read`/`cleanup`; internally delegates actual disk I/O to a lazily-built `LocalWorkspace` (`_ws()`) so there is one disk-IO implementation shared with the repo-workspace path.
- `_safe_segment(value, fallback)` — sanitizes a user/run identifier into one safe path segment, guaranteeing `.`/`..` can never become a path component.
- `sweep_expired(...)` — removes run directories past `RUN_DIR_TTL_HOURS`, honoring a caller-supplied `protected_run_ids` set so an active-but-mtime-stale run is never deleted (mtime alone is insufficient since directory mtime doesn't advance on in-place file edits).
- `serialize_sandbox_deliverable(root, exclude=...)` / `count_sandbox_deliverables(root, ...)` — walk the sandbox and reproduce the legacy in-memory `AgentWorkspace.to_final_output()` string byte-for-byte, reading raw bytes (not `read_text`) to preserve `\r`/`\r\n` exactly and skipping unreadable/non-UTF-8 files rather than failing.

## Why this shape
The module docstring states the isolation goal directly — one user's run can never read or write another's files and a `..` traversal cannot escape the run directory — and comments document a deliberate "move-don't-copy" refactor (D-02/RUNTIME-02) where the bespoke read/write/cleanup logic was delegated to a shared `Workspace` abstraction so artifact workspaces (`has_git=False`, here) and repo workspaces (`has_git=True`) share one disk-IO implementation instead of forking on an `if repo:` branch; the deliverable serializer's byte-exact behavior (including the raw-bytes read) is pinned by a dedicated byte-oracle test.
